leading.text:
level 4 over and over, that's so unsettling

were you going up those stairs on your own?

rain going up into the sky, and your car's a little wooden rowing boat parked neatly between the lines

when you turned round and saw the dog, were you looking out through your own eyes, or more like watching yourself from outside?

"like it always was"

like you'd been waiting there before?

"like he belonged there." i like that

and you, standing there on the platform watching them get smaller... were you just you, or did it feel more like watching it all from somewhere outside?

melting into a horse's head instead of a puddle… that's such a strange, lovely turn

when it started carving itself like that, were you just watching, or were you close to her?

ending right when it's finished, all clear and perfect… that feels kind of right somehow

you said it felt more like someone carving it. was there any sound to it, or was it quiet?

the sea just gone, tall yellow grass where it should be. and him not even looking up

when he handed you that boat, were you you? or were you someone else, or kind of watching it all from outside?

a little round convertible, ha. i can almost picture your aunt pulling up in that

when you were riding along with her, were you just you, like your usual self? or did it feel more like you were watching it all from outside?

just strolling around on the moon in normal clothes like it's any old tuesday, and nobody blinks. that's such dream logic

and a robot doing noodles in glowing bowls 😄 did you go up to its stall?

two bowls, one each 🥹 priya looking out for you even on the moon

what were the noodles like?

that's fine, dreams skip the eating part all the time

paper lanterns just drifting up and up into the black, that's lovely

when you think of them floating away, is it through your own eyes, like you're standing there looking up? or more like you're watching it from somewhere outside?

that's fine, the laughing's the bit that stuck, and that says a lot

you said you were laughing the whole time. was it light and fun all the way through, or did the feeling shift at all as you got higher?

that's fair, dreams do that. it all just seems normal while you're in it

when your brother was waving from the bank, were you seeing him through your own eyes from the boat, or was it more like watching the whole thing from somewhere outside?

that's okay, it just said it. that's how dreams do it

and then you were holding it against your chest, wrapped in newspaper

what was that like, holding it there?

that's so dreams. just there, typing, no faces

did it feel like your own hand, like you were just you in there? or more like you were watching it all from somewhere outside?

flat like cardboard cutouts, all walking the same way... that's eerie

were you walking with them?

paper houses leaning over a narrow street... i can almost see it

when you were walking down it, were you just you, or did it feel more like you were watching from somewhere outside?

the bell coming out as bubbles is so good. and a whole class of little silver fish just going out the window at once

were you one of the fish too?

normal Mr Hale in his brown jacket, then suddenly octopus

do you remember how it started? like was the school already underwater when you got there

hundreds of letters, all with your name on them

did you open any of them?

a red door just standing out there in the snow, no house, nothing

when you were walking toward it with him, were you yourself, like you seeing through your own eyes? or more like watching the two of you from somewhere else?

a country road, with the train running right along it. that matters, i like knowing that

when you think back to being up there, were you just you, or did it feel more like you were watching it happen?
